items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: I brought Wynton Marsalis and Ken Burns on board. I’d been working with Wynton at Jazz at Lincoln Center just as a consultant or as an educator and I had participated as one of the consultants on the Ken Burns Jazz series. So they agreed to join the board

ctx.x: John Lewis, Benny Carter, Duke Ellington for starters, Dizzy Gillespie, Max Roach, Wynton Marsalis.
